summary: First roadmap foundation: stable panel surfaces and bounded correction rejection.

changes.title: Stable panel handoff
changes.detail: The sole incoming panel no longer fades from zero after its outgoing panel is hidden; existing dedicated morphs remain.

changes.title: Private correction receipt
changes.detail: The existing one-use correction rejection expires at 30 seconds and clears on hide, editor changes and private boundaries. Full original-word recall is still pending.
